properties.name: Chittenden Brook Campground
properties.operator: Green Mountain & Finger Lakes National Forests
properties.fee_text: Camping Fee: $15.00 per site per night Fees are payable at the self-service fee station at bulletin board near campground entrance.
properties.restrictions: Maximum stay limit is 14 days in a 30 day period. Dogs must be on a leash at all times. Quiet Hours are 10 PM – 6 AM. Check out time is 2 PM.

properties.name: Greendale Campground
properties.operator: Green Mountain & Finger Lakes National Forests
properties.fee_text: Camping fee of $10.00 per site, per night is payable at the camping self-service fee station and is collected mid-May through October .
properties.season: mid-May—October; site is not accessible via motor vehicle December—April.
properties.restrictions: Each campsite must be limited to 8 people per site Dogs must be on a leash at all times. Quiet Hours are 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM. Check out time is 2:00 PM. Maximum stay is 14 days in any 30-day period.

properties.name: Hapgood Pond Recreation Area
properties.operator: Green Mountain & Finger Lakes National Forests
properties.fee_text: Day-use fees, payable the self-service fee stations located near the entrance to the site: $5.00 per vehicle. Walk-ins and bicyclers have a reduced fee. Camping fees, payable at the camping self-service fee station: $20.00 per site per night.
properties.restrictions: 8 people maximum per site Checkout time is 12:00 PM Dogs must be on a leash at all times Quiet hours are from 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM Maximum stay is 14 days in a 30-day period

properties.name: Grout Pond Recreation Area
properties.operator: Green Mountain & Finger Lakes National Forests
properties.fee_text: Camping Fee: $16.00 per site per night Fees are paid at the self-service pay station located near the entrance to the site.
properties.restrictions: No horses, mountain bikes, or motorized vehicles. Maximum campers per site: 8 people Dogs must be on a leash at all times. Quiet Hours are 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM. Check out time is 12:00 PM. Maximum stay is 14 days in any 30-day period.
